description: External build inputs provenance manifest (absorbed: grok-bot-0.18-reconstructed checksum-pinned build input pattern). Every third-party input consumed at build/CI time is anchored here and verified by scripts/provenance_check.sh before builds ship.

inputs.name: actions/checkout

notes: Tag refs are mutable by design of the providers; `unpinned:*` markers make that honesty explicit instead of faking immutability. Promotion path: replace tag refs with commit-SHA pins and fill real sha256 values — the checker verifies them automatically once present.
